status: scientific design frozen; essential native end-to-end qualification required before collection

supersedes.reason: Direct user instruction: treat AlphaZero as the recipe while preserving one candidate, midnight selection, six-hour training, adequate evaluation and stronger ladder population. Earlier PPO preparations remain unexecuted history; no training games/fits occurred.

method: information-set determinization search and policy/value distillation inspired by AlphaZero
objective: measured whole-player strength and reusable strategic opponent population; no guaranteed improvement

paperFoundation.transfer: Policy/value network guides simulator search; train policy on root visits and bounded value on natural game outcomes; iterate current-policy self-play. Search targets are not PPO actions.
Learned policy/value plus bounded planning; reuse existing tensors and simulator rather than reproduce the original compute regime.
Imperfect information requires information-state reasoning. Sample worlds from actor-visible constraints; this determinization approximation is not ReBeL and has no Nash guarantee.

initialization.name: first-baseline warm start
initialization.model: existing relational actor/critic tensors, no architecture replacement or foreign weights
initialization.valueTransform: tanh(raw existing critic), applied consistently to search value and supervised value loss
initialization.optimizer: new Adam for changed supervised objective; no claim to preserve PPO moments
initialization.proof: Before first fit record exact original actor/critic state_dict equality, new runtime/source identity, immutable initialized checkpoint SHA and reload proof. Preserve raw first-baseline and entire frozen runtime.

search.algorithm: PUCT over independently determinized hypothetical native worlds
search.knownDeckAssumption: Declared pinned mirrored Hammerpult sixty is part of this fixed native scenario; it is not read from actual hidden live zones.
search.informationBoundary: Construct unknown zones solely from actor-visible current state, decisionContext, declared deck multisets and independent searchSeed; conserve multiplicities. Never clone authoritative hidden state or use actual native RNG state/seed. Current reconstruction does not consume complete publicHistory as a posterior constraint; the admitted belief is a current-view constrained approximation, not a complete history-consistent solver.
search.branchContract: begin(rootView,publicHistory,knownDecks,seed); observe(handle)->safeView,toPlay,result; step->fresh nondestructive child; validate(handle,semanticCommand); close(handle); shutdown. Native wire envelope normalized by provider.
search.rootDomain: Complete native-validated semantic legal choices; compare canonical root domain across determinizations. Correct unordered optional/multicard enumeration only when complete domain<=128; explicit legacy route otherwise.
search.fallback: Unsupported root reconstruction/domain gets an attributed existing policy/ranker/helper choice and NO invented search visit target; unsupported search child is a bounded learned-value leaf. Report coverage and failures separately.
search.values: Leaf prediction is from toPlay perspective, convert to explicit root perspective; repeated same-player decisions do not alternate signs blindly. Terminal winner determines exact -1/0/+1.
search.rng: Independent per-game searchSeed; derive root/world streams from searchSeed, observed seat and decision index. Actual native game seed is excluded from the policy/provider input. Split each training game searchSeed by physical seat outside the root-normalized policy; final pairs have separate independently predeclared search seeds per candidate seat.
search.seatConvention: Hypothetical native world seats are root-relative: human is the acting root player (you), opponent is the other player. Physical match seats are used only outside provider to assign actual natural outcomes.
search.informationSetConsistency: Share action priors/Q/visits only by acting-player visible observation plus actor-visible observation/action history and canonical encoded legal domain; never key policy selection by hidden world/handle/RNG/other-player private history. Keep transition handles world-local and distinct observable outcomes in distinct information sets.
search.opponentUncertainty: Separate deck/history-conditioned hidden-card belief from uncertainty over opponent policies. Actual training population is50%currentsearch/25%frozenreference/25%scriptedteacher bygames. Current-network simulated opponent responses are a declared surrogate, not a proven minimax or equilibrium policy. Preserve nontransitive cross-play cells and mixtures.

seatSearchStreams.root: Root/world streams derive only from this independent per-seat search stream and own observed decision index.

search.beliefScope: Native qualification must identify supported states and explicit rejects, including semantic domain and public-fact equality. Retained historical known-card/order constraints that current reconstruction cannot honor must be rejected or conservatively represented before use; missing history conditioning must not be presented as exact belief inference. Report current-view approximation and root coverage separately.

learning.objective: CE(root visit distribution, current legal policy) + MSE(tanh(rawcritic), natural seat-perspective z) + L2 regularization
learning.replay: Up to last four fully admitted batches, max16384 search-target records; exact implementation/actual retained count pinned before start. Supervised targets permit older-policy replay; no PPO ratio or oldLogProb.
learning.labels: Only real search visits on nonforced root domains (>=2legal choices) supply policy targets; only naturally completed game outcomes supply z. No reward from errors or exclusions.
learning.output: Immutable checkpoint and reload-verified receipt after each accepted fit; subsequent self-play uses latest fully verified model.

population.seatBalance: For each frozen anchor, two learner-human and two learner-opponent games; current self-play records both learner seats.
population.purpose: Current-policy search self-play drives iteration; fixed ladder anchors provide stable strategic diversity. This is a declared adaptation, not the original tabula-rasa AlphaZero experiment.

training.admission: Fit only fully natural admitted games with accepted commands, valid privacy/source checks and genuine nonforced search targets. Report actual targeted/fallback decision counts and attempted/discarded games.
training.checkpointRule: Last immutable fully admitted, reload-verified update completed before actual deadlineUtc (actual qualified collection start+sixhours); no selection by wins.
training.recovery: Preserve partial/failed evidence and last valid checkpoint. No fabricated terminal labels, seed reuse, second trajectory or deadline extension; any retry follows predeclared unused seed order and records affected training distribution. Source/hash/privacy mismatch fails closed.
training.resources: Six hours allocated to training separately from evaluation. Four collection lanes initially; measure actual search/native throughput and GPU fit cost. The old plain-policy capacity result is not an AZ throughput forecast.
training.timing: trainingStartedAtUtc is the first actual declared self-play collection child spawn after essential native branch/source/target-binding checks. deadlineUtc=trainingStartedAtUtc+21600seconds, immutable across recovery. Preparation is excluded. firstSuccessfulUpdateAtUtc is separately recorded.
training.qualification: Use held non-strength native branch/information-set/target-binding checks first. The first declared16-game training batch and its successful immutable fit/reload are the SAME single candidate trajectory, not a discarded qualification model. Its collection counts toward the six hours; continue that admitted checkpoint. No outcome-selected qualification data is silently reused for fitting.

monitoring.dataRole: development only; separate compute from training allocation
monitoring.snapshotRule: Last fully verified immutable checkpoint at actual trainingStartedAtUtc+2h and+4h; asynchronous evaluation never reads mutable trainer weights.
monitoring.question: detect very large30percentage-point gain or collapse relative to parity; no claim this panel resolves10point shifts
monitoring.interval: two-sided97.5% Hoeffding perpoint; Bonferroni simultaneous95% over two planned points
monitoring.trainingDecision: operational visibility, no win-based stopping or checkpoint selection; finalfresh confirmation determines strength
monitoring.factory: full AlphaZero-style candidate, same declared search budget as final
monitoring.interpretation: Two fixed development panels target only very large30-point excursions; no checkpoint selection or10-point inference from this panel.

confirmation.candidateSelection: Last fully verified update of the single search-distillation trajectory before actual six-hour deadline; freeze full player/source/config before unseen confirmation.
confirmation.comparison: one complete search-guided Model7 player versus complete first-baseline on the unchanged frozen native game scenario

strengthPlan.effect: 10 percentage points in candidate game score above parity (0.60 versus 0.50)
strengthPlan.independentUnit: independent uniformly sampled uint32 seed block; both candidate seats averaged within each block
strengthPlan.uncertainty: fixed-endpoint two-sided 95% Hoeffding interval over 512 bounded paired means; no stopping on observed wins

sampleJustification.assumptions: independent seed blocks; pair scores bounded in [0,1]; no independence assumed between seats
sampleJustification.selectionMultiplicity: one preselected final candidate and one fresh comparison; development outcomes never pooled

strengthPlan.decision: lower bound >0.50 demonstrates scenario-specific improvement; upper bound <0.60 rules out the targeted 10-point gain; otherwise unresolved. Preserve baseline until separately reviewed promotion.
strengthPlan.scope: fixed native scenario, not a claim of strength across all decks or official-client play
strengthPlan.failureContract: unchanged: policy forfeit, command cap draw, shared harness failure stops and invalidates incomplete confirmation
strengthPlan.stopping: all 512 pairs at fixed endpoint; operational wall cap 8h, no statistical claim if incomplete
strengthPlan.resources: six CPU lanes after a separate capacity check; same single-thread model servers, no paid infrastructure; actual cost recorded

seedAudit.method: crypto.randomBytes uint32 sampling without replacement; excluded all 5-10 digit integers from existing local run/repro JSON and available pilot receipt

confirmation.resourceNote: 512pairs/1024games retain adequate10-point planning. Search latency must be measured; plain-policy 5.5h projection is inapplicable. Eight-hour cap is provisional until actual full-player qualification; surface any concrete contract/resource conflict before changing it.

populationPreservation.preserve: every admitted immutable checkpoint with full policy/runtime/selection/helper/behavior identity and training lineage
populationPreservation.retention: A specialist need not beat the champion overall to remain a useful frozen training opponent.
populationPreservation.comparison: Use existing canonical cross-play and paired uncertainty; keep missing edges unmeasured and evaluation seeds independent.

externalCode.role: Selective implementation aid after correctness/license review. No foreign weights, missing trainer assumptions, or literal uncorrected search reuse.

audit.conclusion: Public Trevon MIT source supplies no trainer/PPO update; native search/distillation is independently implemented. No CABT games or matched engine benchmark; retain native engine and optimize.

limitations: Determinization search can suffer strategy fusion and is not an information-set equilibrium solver; quantify support and assumptions rather than claim ReBeL guarantees.
Unsupported branch roots and large/unsupported prompt domains remain explicit fallback and supply no fake visit target. Sparse coverage cannot be presented as an implemented full-game search success.

Whole-batch exclusions may correlate with policy behavior or game length and bias retained experience. Report attempted/admitted/discarded data by reason/opponent/seat/parent; do not call it unbiased.
The candidate combines search, changed supervised objective and policy coverage; final whole-player comparison cannot causally identify component effects without ablations.
Fixed mirrored scenario and declared deck assumption do not establish other-deck or official-client strength.

Current root reconstruction uses visible current state and decision context, not complete historical order/reveal conditioning. Native source qualification scopes supported states; no complete history-posterior or game-theoretic equilibrium claim.
publicPreservation: source/config/seeds/hash/results versioned; private weights,rawrecords,journals and input paths external

nativeExecution.adoption: qualified native-state-copy/1.0.0 for new actual games, same deck/helper/copy-mode inputs; separate hypothetical branch worker; no frozenD mutation
nativeExecution.qualification: 20independent paired-policy seeds, exact gameplay/behavior; full private qualification receipt/config/source hashes pinned in execution manifest
nativeExecution.comparisonIdentity: Both actual players share same declared qualified native worker; baseline player bytes unchanged. New native implementation gets an explicit separate ladder pool identity.

prelaunchAmendment.reason: Record exact implemented independent seat streams and current-view belief approximation before any candidate game/fit; scientific objective, seeds, stopping and sample sizes unchanged.
